author: musho7-dev
subject: Workshop: 25 new items across all categories (58 total)
body:
- Bodies: Bug (round, sunroof), Jeep (open top, spare tire), Box Truck
  (cargo box), Hot Rod (low, chrome pipes)
- Engines: Turbo, Electric (no smoke, much lower fuel use), Jet
  (turbine with blue flame, fastest)
- Wheels: Drift (fast, slidey), Tractor (chevron treads), Spiky (best grip)
- Paints: Mint, Lime, Sky, Navy, Cherry, Chrome (also in TUNE)
- Decals: Lightning, Polka dots, Zigzag, Hearts, Wave (also in TUNE)
- Extras: Roof rack, Antenna (wobbles), Bull horns, Tail fin (+10% air)
